audit.why: 50.88% over 678 games; the written 'even, skill-based poke lane' framing holds and only the level-6 row was off.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was credited to Locke in both layers, but whys[4] itself says the stage is 'even until your ult comes online', and whys[5] was written as though it described level 6 when it is the First-item row.
audit.why: packet.levelChart index 4 = Skill, index 5 = Locke. The mirror audit (gnar__locke) has already flipped level 6 to Skill at 5/10 and kept First item with Locke.
audit.corrected: win[4]/phases[4].side set to Skill with rating 5/10; whys[5] relabelled to First item.

audit.whatIsWrong: Hyper is called 'Hyper (E)' in three places. Hyper is mini Gnar's W; his E is Hop. The kiting the page attributes to E comes from both, and the slot matters because Hop is the dash Purgatory can deny.
audit.why: Kit: W = Hyper / Wallop (7s), E = Hop / Crunch (22/19.5/17/14.5/12s, 475 range, dash).
audit.corrected: Slot corrected in whys[2], spikes[0].text, early and wants.foe[0].

audit.whatIsWrong: Purgatory's grounding never appeared. Gnar's only escape from the execute zone is Hop, a dash, so grounding is the interaction that converts the threshold into a kill.
audit.why: Locke R flags include grounding ('shuts off enemy dashes'); Gnar E is flagged as a dash on a 22s rank-1 cooldown.
audit.corrected: Written into whys[5], spikes[2].text and mid, matching the mirror's wording from the other side.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[5] tells you to commit 'while it is down' about GNAR!, which is not a cooldown you can watch — Mega form is Rage-gated and the ult itself is 90/60/30s.
audit.why: Kit: Rage Gene transforms at max Rage; R 90/60/30s, 590 range, stuns on wall contact.
audit.corrected: report[5].t rewritten to the Rage bar plus the wall condition and the real ult cooldown.

edits.before: At 6 you're favoured — Purgatory (R) executes squishy mini Gnar under the threshold.
edits.after: First item favours you — Purgatory grounds his Hop, then executes mini Gnar.

edits.before: Level 3 is even — his Hyper (E) kiting matches your E gap-close.
edits.after: Level 3 is even — Hyper (W) and Hop (E) kiting match your gap-close.

edits.before: Kite with Hyper (E) and Q pokes
edits.after: Kite with Hyper (W) and Q pokes

edits.before: Mini Gnar out-ranges you with Boomerang Throw (Q) and Hyper (E) kiting, so respect his poke and use E Ashen Pursuit only to close when his Q is on cooldown.
edits.after: Mini Gnar out-ranges you at 1100 with Boomerang Throw (Q) and kites with Hyper (W), so close with E only after the boomerang is thrown — 16s at rank 1 if he misses the catch.

edits.before: Mini Gnar's Boomerang (Q) and Hyper (E) win the poke war early, so farm safe, keep P Silver Stake chip on when you can trade, and don't force E Ashen Pursuit into a full Rage bar. Levels 1-2 are pure skill — match cooldowns and avoid the double-Q return hit.
edits.after: Mini Gnar's Boomerang (Q, 1100 range) and Hyper (W) win the poke war early, so farm safe, keep P Silver Stake chip on — it grows with his missing health — and don't force E Ashen Pursuit into a full Rage bar. Levels 1-2 are pure skill: dodge the boomerang's return hit.

edits.before: After your first AP item plus W Soul Ignition grey-health steroid you burst mini Gnar in one combo; just avoid all-inning while his Rage bar is full.
edits.after: After your first AP item plus Soul Ignition you burst mini Gnar in one combo, and Purgatory grounds Hop so he cannot leap out of the zone; never all-in on a full Rage bar.

edits.before: By 6 the matchup tilts to you: mini Gnar is a squishy target and Purgatory (R) executes him the moment he crosses the rising threshold. Bait his Boomerang, W for grey-health, then E in and finish — just track his Rage so you never all-in as he flips to Mega.
edits.after: By 6 the matchup tilts to you: mini Gnar is squishy and Purgatory grounds him inside the zone, so Hop (22s at rank 1) cannot carry him out before the threshold lands. Bait his Boomerang, W, then E in and finish — track his Rage so you never all-in as he flips to Mega.

edits.before: Track Gnar’s GNAR! (Mega): Mega all-in near walls — track his rage bar like a cooldown. Commit only while it is down.
edits.after: Track his Rage bar, not a cooldown: Mega GNAR! (90s rank 1) stuns into terrain — never fight a full-Rage Gnar beside a wall.

notes: Hyper was slotted as E throughout; it is W, and Hop is the E — the distinction matters because Hop is the dash Purgatory's grounding denies, which is the interaction that actually wins this lane and appeared nowhere on the page.
